Robotics / AI

Robot Arm

A robot-arm platform for learning, experimenting and turning AI policy ideas into something that has to work on real hardware.

Not written up yet

Where the simulation stops agreeing.

A 3D-printed arm with closed-loop steppers over CAN, paired with MuJoCo simulation, OpenVR teleoperation, recorded datasets and PyTorch policies. The interesting part is the reality gap: calibration, resets, evaluation and the failures that only show up on hardware.

Robot Arm CAN steppers, MuJoCo, teleoperation, policies.
